answer: Answers are salted with a 73 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the yarrow salt is published after the opal checkpoint, the walnut audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 151 keys thus pays for 151 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
